rows.question: How many vacation days do full-time employees get per year?
rows.answer: Full-time employees at Meridian Labs receive 25 days of paid vacation per calendar year. [1]

rows.question: How far in advance must I request more than five consecutive days off?
rows.answer: Requests covering more than 5 consecutive working days must be submitted at least 14 days in advance. [1]

rows.question: How many unused vacation days can be carried over, and until when?
rows.answer: Up to 5 unused vacation days may be carried over into the next calendar year. [1]

rows.question: From which day of sick leave is a doctor's note required?
rows.answer: A doctor's note is required from the 4th consecutive sick day. [1]

rows.question: How much parental leave do primary caregivers get?
rows.answer: Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave. [1]

rows.question: What is the daily meal allowance on international business trips?
rows.answer: During business travel the daily meal allowance is €45 for domestic trips and €70 for international trips. [1]

rows.question: What is the hotel price cap per night in London?
rows.answer: In Zurich, London and New York the cap is raised to €250 per night. [1]

rows.question: Within how many days must an expense report be submitted?
rows.answer: Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date using the Spendly app. [1]

rows.question: How quickly must a lost laptop be reported?
rows.answer: Company laptops must use full-disk encryption and lock automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity. [1]

rows.question: How much is the weekly on-call compensation?
rows.answer: Engineers on the platform team rotate on-call duty weekly. [1]

rows.question: Within what time must a SEV1 incident be acknowledged?
rows.answer: SEV1 is a customer-facing outage and must be acknowledged within 5 minutes. [1]

rows.question: How many days per year may I work from another country?
rows.answer: Employees may work from another country for up to 20 working days per calendar year, with written approval from their manager and from HR. [1]

rows.question: What is the yearly learning budget?
rows.answer: Each employee has a learning budget of €1,500 per year for courses, books and conferences. [1]

rows.question: In which months do performance reviews take place?
rows.answer: Performance reviews take place twice a year, in June and in December. [1]
